def components(G):
    H,W = G.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(G,bool); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if G[r,c]==1 and not seen[r,c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen[r,c]=True; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy in (-1,0,1):
                        for dx in (-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and G[ny,nx]==1 and not seen[ny,nx]:
                                seen[ny,nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps

def valid_rect(G,r0,r1,c0,c1):
    H,W=G.shape
    ones_in=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if G[r,c]==1]
    if not ones_in: return None
    # each side must contain >=1 one
    if not any(r==r0 for r,c in ones_in): return None
    if not any(r==r1 for r,c in ones_in): return None
    if not any(c==c0 for r,c in ones_in): return None
    if not any(c==c1 for r,c in ones_in): return None
    # all 1s on border (no interior extras) ; also require r1>r0 and c1>c0
    if r1==r0 or c1==c0: return None
    for r,c in ones_in:
        if r0<r<r1 and c0<c<c1: return None
    # maximality: cannot extend in any direction keeping validity
    for ext in ((r0-1,r1,c0,c1),(r0,r1+1,c0,c1),(r0,r1,c0-1,c1),(r0,r1,c0,c1+1)):
        a,b,cc,d = ext
        if a<0 or b>=H or cc<0 or d>=W: continue
        if valid_rect_raw(G,a,b,cc,d): return None
    return ones_in

def valid_rect_raw(G,r0,r1,c0,c1):
    # validity without maximality check
    ones_in=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if G[r,c]==1]
    if not ones_in or r1==r0 or c1==c0: return False
    if not any(r==r0 for r,c in ones_in): return False
    if not any(r==r1 for r,c in ones_in): return False
    if not any(c==c0 for r,c in ones_in): return False
    if not any(c==c1 for r,c in ones_in): return False
    for r,c in ones_in:
        if r0<r<r1 and c0<c<c1: return False
    return True

def find_rects(G):
    rects=[]
    H,W=G.shape
    for comp in components(G):
        rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in comp]
        cand=[]
        for r0 in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
            for r1 in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
                for c0 in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                    for c1 in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                        v=valid_rect(G,r0,r1,c0,c1)
                        if v: cand.append(((r0,r1,c0,c1),set(v)))
        # exact cover search (min count)
        target=set(comp); best=None
        def search(covered,chosen):
            nonlocal best
            if best is not None and len(chosen)>=len(best): return
            if covered>=target: best=list(chosen); return
            rem=target-covered
            # pick an uncovered cell, try rects containing it
            cell=next(iter(rem))
            for bb,s in cand:
                if cell in s and bb not in chosen:
                    chosen.append(bb); search(covered|s,chosen); chosen.pop()
        search(set(),[])
        rects.append((best,cand))
    return rects

def solve(G, dbg=False):
    H,W=G.shape
    out=G.copy()
    rects=find_rects(G)
    ones=set(zip(*np.where(G==1))) if False else {(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in zip(*np.where(G==1))}
    contrib={}  # cell -> best rank (1 orig, 0 hole, 3 fill, 2 ring); rank: 1 best
    prio={'one':4,'hole':3,'fill':2,'ring':1}
    cells={}
    for best,_ in rects:
        if best is None: continue
        for (r0,r1,c0,c1) in best:
            gr0,gr1=max(0,r0-1),min(H-1,r1+1)
            gc0,gc1=max(0,c0-1),min(W-1,c1+1)
            # border gaps count
            gaps=sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)
                     if (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)) and G[r,c]==0)
            if dbg: print('rect',(r0,r1,c0,c1),'gaps',gaps)
            if gaps==1: continue
            for r in range(gr0,gr1+1):
                for c in range(gc0,gc1+1):
                    ring = (r in (gr0,gr1) or c in (gc0,gc1))
                    kind='ring' if ring else 'fill'
                    cells.setdefault((r,c),set()).add(kind)
    # global holes
    for (r,c),ks in list(cells.items()):
        if G[r,c]==0:
            dmin=min(max(abs(r-r2),abs(c-c2)) for r2,c2 in ones)
            if dmin>=2: ks.add('hole')
    for (r,c),ks in cells.items():
        if G[r,c]==1: out[r,c]=1; continue
        if 'hole' in ks: out[r,c]=0
        elif 'fill' in ks: out[r,c]=3
        elif 'ring' in ks: out[r,c]=2
    return out, rects

steps.input:
for name,(gi,go) in [("d1",(d1i,d1o)),("d3",(d3i,d3o)),("d4",(d4i,d4o))]:
    comps=components(gi)
    print("=== "+name)
    for comp in comps:
        if not has_cycle(comp): continue
        ones=set(comp)
        all1={(r,c) for r in range(gi.shape[0]) for c in range(gi.shape[1]) if gi[r,c]==1}
        other=all1-ones
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs_=[p[1] for p in comp]
        a,b=min(rs),max(rs); d_,e=min(cs_),max(cs_)
        rows=range(max(0,a-1),min(gi.shape[0],b+2)); cols=range(max(0,d_-1),min(gi.shape[1],e+2))
        odd=[]
        for r in rows:
            for c in cols:
                if gi[r,c]!=0: continue
                mind=min(max(abs(r-r1),abs(c-c1)) for r1,c1 in ones)
                adj=any((r+dr,c+dc) in ones for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1))
                exp=int(go[r,c])
                odd.append((r,c,mind,adj,exp))
        # show non-adjacent painted cells and adjacent non-painted
        print(" comp bbox",(a,b,d_,e))
        print("  non-adj cells:",[(r,c,mind,exp) for r,c,mind,adj,exp in odd if not adj])
        print("  adj-but-0:",[(r,c,mind) for r,c,mind,adj,exp in odd if adj and exp==0])

import re
def parse_grids(txt):
    res={}
    # demo pairs
    for m in re.finditer(r'Demo pair (\d+) (input|output) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n?)+)', txt):
        idx,kind,h,w,body=int(m.group(1)),m.group(2),int(m.group(3)),int(m.group(4)),m.group(5)
        rows=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in body.strip().split('\n')]
        res[f'd{idx}{kind[0]}']=(h,w,rows)
    m=re.search(r'Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n?)+)', txt)
    if m:
        h,w=int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))
        rows=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in m.group(3).strip().split('\n')]
        res['test']=(h,w,rows)
    return res
